import sys
import bisect

mo1 = 998244353
mo2 = 1000000007

n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
a = []
m = n
while m > 0:
    a.append(m % 10)
    m //= 10
a.reverse()
length = len(a)

def dig(b, l):
    re = 0
    for i in range(l):
        re = re * 10 + b[i]
    return re

def Rank(b, l):
    ans = 0
    for di in range(1, a[0] + 1):
        for i in range(1, min(l, di) + 1):
            for j in range(1 if i == 1 else 0, b[i - 1]):
                numl = 0
                numr = 0
                for p in range(i - 1):
                    numl = numr = numl * 10 + b[p]
                numl = numr = numl * 10 + j
                for p in range(i, di):
                    numl = numl * 10
                    numr = numr * 10 + 9
                numr = min(numr, n)
                if numl <= numr:
                    ans += numr - numl + 1
        if di <= l:
            ans += 1
    return ans

def F(a, di):
    return ((-dig(a, di) + Rank(a, di)) % mo1 + mo1) % mo1

dif = [0] * 15
q1 = [0] * 1000010
q2 = [0] * 1000010
sq2 = [0] * 1000010

def dfs(t, ed, q, v):
    if t == ed:
        q.append((v + i * dif[t]) % mo1 for i in range(10))
        return
    for i in range(10):
        dfs(t + 1, ed, q, (v + i * dif[t]) % mo1)

def update(di, i, j):
    b = a[:]
    b[i - 1] = j
    for p in range(i, di):
        b[p] = 0
    bas = F(b, di)
    for p in range(i, di):
        b[p] = 1
        dif[p + 1] = (F(b, di) + mo1 - bas) % mo1
        b[p] = 0
    global ans
    if di - i == 0:
        ans = (ans + bas) % mo2
        return
    if di - i == 1:
        for p in range(10):
            ans = (ans + (bas + p * dif[di]) % mo1) % mo2
        return
    mid = (di + i) // 2
    q1.clear()
    q2.clear()
    dfs(i, mid, q1, bas)
    dfs(mid, di, q2, 0)
    q2_sorted = sorted(q2)
    sum_q2 = sum(q2_sorted) % mo2
    for val in q1:
        p = bisect.bisect_left(q2_sorted, mo1 - val)
        ans = (ans + sum_q2 + p * val) % mo2
        ans = (ans + (len(q2_sorted) - p) * (mo2 - mo1)) % mo2

ans = 0
for di in range(1, length + 1):
    for i in range(1, di + 1):
        l = 1 if i == 1 else 0
        r = a[i - 1] - 1 if di == length else 9
        for j in range(l, r + 1):
            if j != a[i - 1]:
                update(di, i, j)
    ans = (ans + F(a, di)) % mo2

print(ans)
